attribution: Retraction Watch data via Crossref (https://gitlab.com/crossref/retraction-watch-data), commit a987928a816e0a6f8bb7f8ebc68ad15fe44ab3c4; selected fields of at most 120 records; other columns left empty. Cited as the source requests; not a redistribution of the dataset.
method: Write the attributed Retraction Watch subset fixture of Stage 04 Step 8 (owner Step 8 item 10).  Method. The pinned snapshot (receipt ``rw-a987928``) is checked byte for byte. Each vertical-slice bundle named in SPECIFICATION.md S-7.4 / VS-1..VS-3 (all previously exposed design cases, none a Stage 03 evaluation or holdout bundle) is extracted offline with the accepted Stage 03 extractor, and its valid DOI and PMID keys are collected. Every key is queried alone (Q1), and every DOI x PMID pair of one bundle is queried together (Q2, a superset of the pairs NORMALIZE forms), on an index built from the full snapshot, through the Stage 04 bounded lookup (``Index.gather_bounded``, 16 MiB). The fixture keeps the Record IDs of every event any of those queries returns (the bridge closure is the engine's own), with the same selected fields as the Stage 02 fixture; other columns are left empty. The script then builds an index from the fixture alone and checks that every query gives the same state, status, value, dates, event identities and record ids as on the full index. Disagreements are written to the manifest and fail the run. No synthetic row is added.
